pain_points.text: Only 0.88% of about 500,000 visitors interacted with the assistant, so engagement is low
Outstanding change requests from Abdul (as of Apr 8) and custom development needed for the new website theme

Email queries were stacking up (since resolved) and the chat widget was not always visible on the store
Worry that negative customer feedback and social media negativity hurt brand reputation; chargeback prevention

stated_goals.text: AI handles tier-1 support queries on its own, with human agents on tier-2 such as refunds and damaged items
